title: Zells shin measurements
$comment: Variable names are DRAFT pending confirmation with the CAD collaborator against the Onshape model; do not build the Onshape integration against unconfirmed names. All values are millimeters.

Leg_Length.description: Total leg length from knee to ankle, in millimeters.
